project_type: React 19 SPA with Vite, dark-themed AI company dashboard
test_framework: No test framework configured - build verification only
verification_instructions: 1. Run tsc --noEmit for type checking. 2. Run vite build for production build verification.
environment_constraints: Network available for npm installs. No Docker needed. No test framework - use TypeScript compilation and Vite build as verification.
contribution_requirements: Dark theme with deep navy/charcoal backgrounds (--sidebar-bg: #12131f, dark-bg: #0f1117, dark-surface: #1a1b2e, dark-card: #1e2035). Card component uses bg-dark-surface with border-white/[0.08]. All pages use lucide-react icons and the dark color scheme.
key_patterns: Pages are in src/pages/, components in src/components/{feature}/. Existing Office uses useOffice() hook from src/hooks/useOffice.ts which fetches agents and tasks from API. Static demo data pattern (hardcoded mock arrays) used in Dashboard.tsx. Dark theme colors: bg-dark-bg, bg-dark-surface, text-white, text-gray-400 for secondary. Card component from @/components/common/Card. TailwindCSS with custom colors defined in tailwind.config.js. Animations defined in tailwind keyframes. Path alias @/ points to src/.
directory_structure: dashboard/ - React SPA root. src/pages/ - page components. src/components/ - grouped by feature (office/, common/, layout/). src/hooks/ - custom React hooks. src/api/ - API client functions. src/types/ - TypeScript interfaces. src/config/ - configuration objects.
